slots.notes: Fullscreen fixed looping hero background video behind all content; object-cover, z-index -10, autoPlay/muted/playsInline.
Background image for the Sprint Metrics card in the left column; object-cover, anchored top center, behind stat columns.
Three overlapping circular team-member portrait avatars in the section header Crew cluster (-space-x-2), followed by a +9 counter.
Three overlapping circular portrait avatars in the bottom-left of TaskCard 1 (Sprint Planning Call), followed by a +7 counter.
Two overlapping circular assignee portrait avatars in the bottom-left of TaskCard 2 (Layout Critique).
Three overlapping circular portrait avatars in the bottom-left of TaskCard 3 (Zenith Crew Check), followed by a +5 counter.
Display/serif typeface (Instrument Serif regular+italic) applied via .font-serif-display to brand name, greeting, and Voice Input heading.

mechanic: Static 12-column dashboard grid of white pill/cards floating over a fullscreen fixed looping video, with staggered fadeUp entrance animations (opacity+translateY) cascaded via per-element animationDelay.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3 + lucide-react icons; Google Fonts link in index.html, custom fadeUp keyframe and .font-serif-display utility in index.css.
reskinNotes: Status/tag palette (green-500/yellow-400/red-500), the red-400->orange-500 avatar gradient, the #DBECFC light-blue accent surface, and the yellow X icon stroke (#EAB308) are hardcoded as Tailwind utilities/inline SVG in markup rather than tokens; all copy (brand name, nav, task cards, stats, waveform heights) is hardcoded inline; layout uses fixed pixel-scaled type ramps (e.g. 80-140px score, 28-42px greeting) tuned to Instrument Serif metrics, so a swapped display font may need ramp retuning.
